    class KeepaliveManager < Coolio::TimerWatcher
      def initialize(timeout)
        super(1, true)

      def add(sock)
        @cons[sock] = sock
      end

      def delete(sock)
        @cons.delete(sock)
      end

      def on_timer
        @cons.each_pair {|sock,val|
          if sock.step_idle > @timeout
            sock.close
          end
        }
      end
    end

    def multi_workers_ready?

    end

    def start
      @_event_loop_run_timeout = @blocking_timeout

      super

      log.debug "listening http", bind: http_listen_bind, port: http_listen_port

      @km = KeepaliveManager.new(http_keepalive_timeout_value)
      event_loop_attach(@km)

      server_create_connection(:in_http, http_listen_port, bind: http_listen_bind, backlog: @backlog, &method(:on_server_connect))

    def on_request(path_info, params)

          time = resolve_record_time(record_time, record, params)
          append_http_event_to_stream(mes, time, record)

      end

      request_success_response

    def on_server_connect(conn)

    def parse_params_default(params)

      if policy && policy[:reject_empty] && params.nil?

      unless http_payload_parser_ready?

        end
      elsif js = params['json']
        unpack_http_json_records(js) do |record|
          yield nil, record
        end
      elsif ndjson = params['ndjson']
        unpack_http_ndjson_records(ndjson) do |record|
          yield nil, record

    def parse_params_with_parser(params)
      policy = @http_payload_policy
      parser = policy[:custom_parser] || @custom_parser
      record_key = policy[:record_parameter] || EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER
      if content = params[record_key]
        parser.parse(content) do |time, record|

        raise "'#{record_key}' parameter is required"

      record

    def convert_time_field(record)
      policy = @http_time_policy
      time_key = http_record_time_key
      keep_key = policy[:keep_time_key]
      parser = policy[:record_time_parser]

      if time_key.nil? || record.nil?
        return http_time_now
      end

      t = if keep_key
            record[time_key]
          else
            record.delete(time_key)

      if t
        if parser
          parser.parse(t)
        else
          Fluent::EventTime.from_time(Time.at(t))

      else
        http_time_now

    end

    def unpack_http_json_records(js)
      policy = @http_payload_policy
      backend = http_json_backend_name
      if js.nil? || (policy[:reject_empty] && js.respond_to?(:empty?) && js.empty?)
        yield nil
        return

      return yield nil if backend.nil?

      obj = Fluent::PluginHelper::Parser.load_http_json_document(self, js)
      expand_http_root_object(obj) do |record|

    def unpack_http_msgpack_records(data)
      policy = @http_payload_policy
      unpacker = http_msgpack_unpacker
      if data.nil?
        yield nil
        return
      end

      if unpacker.nil? || policy[:enabled] == false
        yield nil
        return

      unpacker.feed_each(data) do |obj|
        coerced = Fluent::PluginHelper::Parser.coerce_http_root_object(self, obj)
        expand_http_root_object(coerced) do |record|
          yield record

    def unpack_http_ndjson_records(ndjson)
      policy = @http_payload_policy
      text = ndjson.to_s
      if policy[:reject_empty] && text.empty?
        yield nil
        return

      text.split(/\r?\n/).each do |line|

      if obj.is_a?(Hash)

      elsif obj.is_a?(Array)
        obj.each do |record|

          else

      else

      ctype = content_type.to_s

        params[policy[:record_parameter] || EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER] = body
      elsif http_payload_form_content?(ctype)

      elsif http_payload_msgpack_content?(ctype)
        params['msgpack'] = body
      elsif http_payload_ndjson_content?(ctype)
        params['ndjson'] = body

      ctype = content_type.to_s

      RES_403_STATUS = "403 Forbidden".freeze

      # Respond with `200 OK` to accommodate it.

        end

        if @parser.http_method == 'OPTIONS'.freeze

      end

      def closing?
        @next_close
      end

      def send_response(code, header, body)

        header.each_pair {|k,v|
          data << "#{k}: #{v}\r\n"

        data << "\r\n".freeze

          data << "#{k}: #{v}\r\n"
        }

        @io.write(data)
      end

        @owner.cors_origin_allowed?(@origin)
      end

require_relative '../helper'
require 'fluent/test/driver/input'
require 'fluent/plugin/in_http'

class HttpInputTest < Test::Unit::TestCase
  class << self
    def startup
      @server = ServerEngine::SocketManager::Server.open
      ENV['SERVERENGINE_SOCKETMANAGER_PATH'] = @server.path.to_s
    end

    def shutdown
      @server.close
    end
  end

  def setup
    Fluent::Test.setup
    @port = unused_port
  end

  def teardown
    Timecop.return
    @port = nil
  end

  def config
    %[
      port #{@port}
      bind "127.0.0.1"
      body_size_limit 10m
      keepalive_timeout 5
      respond_with_empty_img true
     use_204_response false
    ]
  end

  def create_driver(conf=config)
    Fluent::Test::Driver::Input.new(Fluent::Plugin::HttpInput).configure(conf)
  end
